items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Benny Carter being the musician that he was, he groomed her

ctx.x: He came through town and he saw it, so Basie said, 'Well, take her,' 'cause we weren't going to take her. Benny groomed her to where you get Savannah Churchill. She looked good, she had talent. Benny Carter being the musician that he was, he groomed her and took her around and things. Now we ain't got nothing to do with that because the War is on and we are doing our thing. Now we get back to New York and I remember Thelma Carpenter and I said, we'll get her. Well, her mother had to be along. I said, 'Oh, my…
Coleman Hawkins took her over where?
